title: PolinRider: malicious npm releases
description: Releases OpenSourceMalware inventoried as malicious in its PolinRider case study, where a maintainer account was used to ship BeaverTail through ordinary-looking package updates. The report notes that at the time of writing only one of these releases had been pulled from the registry. Each entry is a specific published version, in name@version form.
disclaimer: Third-party-reported, not independently verified per release by Chollima Hunter. These are version-pinned indicators on purpose: for a compromised legitimate package the name identifies the victim project, not the threat, so a bare package name is not carried here and inclusion of a version says only that the cited report describes that release as malicious. Check the cited post before acting on any single entry.

title: ChainVeil and ViteVenom: malicious npm releases
description: Releases OpenSourceMalware attributes to the ChainVeil and ViteVenom clusters of the same campaign. Most are typosquats of build-tooling packages -- names one character or one word away from tailwind-merge, sass-format, rate-limiter-flexible and the Vite ecosystem -- published by the operator rather than injected into anyone else's project. Each entry is a specific published version, in name@version form.

title: axios compromise: affected releases
description: Releases of axios, and of the transitive dependency used to reach it, that OpenSourceMalware reports as carrying malicious code. axios is a legitimate package with roughly 100 million weekly downloads; these version numbers identify the compromised releases, and the package itself is the victim. Each entry is a specific published version, in name@version form. The report relays Google Threat Intelligence Group's attribution of the compromise to UNC1069 and Microsoft's to Sapphire Sleet, names this site files under the APT38 cluster; it does not tie the activity to Contagious Interview, so the releases carry the APT38 label here.
disclaimer: Third-party-reported, not independently verified per release by Chollima Hunter.
